contact.meta_title: Contact Camelot Flows | Brief a Web or AI Build
contact.meta_description: Tell Camelot Flows about your website, automation, AI agent, or agency overflow project. Get a clear reply from the builder within 24 hours.
contact.hero_lead: Describe what you're trying to build. I'll read it, think about it, and reply with either a clear next step or an honest "this isn't the right fit."
contact.form_label_goal: What are you trying to accomplish?
contact.form_placeholder_goal: Describe the problem or goal in plain language. No need to be formal — a few sentences is fine.
contact.form_note: I read every message and reply within 24 hours.
contact.side_card_1_p: You'll talk to me directly — Alexandru, the person who will build your project. No account managers, no handoffs.
contact.side_card_2_p: I respond to every message within one business day. I'm in EET (UTC+2), which overlaps fully with Western Europe and reaches US East Coast mornings.
contact.side_card_3_p: I'll confirm whether the project fits one of my productized tiers or needs a custom scope. Either way, you'll have a clear price before any work starts.
contact.side_call_lead: Prefer to book a call directly?
contact.side_call_note: Free, no obligation. I'll ask about your project and tell you whether I can help.
